name: FINEMAP (effect-size and regional-heritability extension)
model_likelihood: Configuration-specific Gaussian additive linear regression of standardized phenotypes on standardized genotypes; residual variance learned per configuration.
prior: Independent zero-mean Gaussian effects with common variance; large-effect branch averages Bayes factors over a uniform variance grid.
inference_algorithm: Shotgun Stochastic Search over causal configurations followed by Bayesian model averaging.
estimand: Variant PIPs; model-averaged regional heritability; marginal and inclusion-conditional posterior effect-size means and standard deviations.
data_input: GWAS marginal effect-to-standard-error ratios, pairwise sample correlations and univariate residual variance estimates; individual-level data provide the underlying formulation.
tunable_settings: Maximum number of causal variants; effect-size prior variance; large-effect branch uses a four-point equidistant variance grid and a 1% heritability threshold.
